ASUS TUF Gaming VG259Q5A 24.5" FHD IPS 200Hz Professional Gaming Monitor


Unlock your true gaming potential and experience ultra-smooth visual performance with the ASUS TUF Gaming VG259Q5A. Designed specifically for competitive esports players and hardcore gamers, this precision-engineered 24.5-inch Full HD (1920x1080) monitor features an elite 200Hz refresh rate that eliminates motion blur and input lag, giving you a massive split-second advantage in fast-paced first-person shooters, racing simulators, and battle royale games.


Equipped with a premium Fast IPS panel, the VG259Q5A delivers stunningly accurate color reproduction and vibrant graphics with wide 178-degree viewing angles, ensuring crystal-clear visual fidelity even from extreme positions. Combined with a lightning-fast response time and support for Adaptive-Sync (FreeSync Premium) technology, it provides a seamless, tear-free gameplay experience by dynamically matching your graphics card's frame rate. Wrapped in a signature rugged, military-inspired TUF chassis with ASUS Shadow Boost technology to clarify dark map areas, this monitor is the ultimate weapon for your desktop gaming setup.
